notes.title: VoC 2D Racer is now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1][b]We're on STEAM[/b][/h1]
Veg out Crew are taking it to the track, with an all new 2d racing game. Veg out Crew 2D Racer is in the works and we now finally have a steam page!

[h2][b]Race, Shoot, Boost, Dodge and do it all![/b][/h2]
Get ready to race within the Veg out World, non stop action, your favourite veg out cars, weapons and radical tracks. Your level of skills and experience will play a massive part in gaining the place of the most heroic racer the Veg out Crew have seen!

Check out some of the imagery below and what else are you waiting for? Buckle up, get locked and loaded and race your way to stardom!
